story.iWant: the calm reference to revert to par as an off-venue stablecoin price does
story.soThat: the note can say whether "D* breaks on the clock" is the model or the random walk
story.tasks: - OU update (AC: 1) - Fit and scenario (AC: 2, 3) - OU surface (AC: 4) - Verdict, ADR, figures, close out (AC: 5–7)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: See story file ACs 1–7. The OU update in AC 1 and the fit rule in AC 2 are normative; κ is never tuned by eye.

docs.doc: σ's fit; add κ beside it.

existing.reason: OU branch; one draw per step unchanged.

dependencies.python: numpy only for the AR(1) (least squares); no scipy/statsmodels.

story-context.constraints: - No kernel/ or protocol/ changes beyond config.py; PHASE_ORDER_VERSION stays 1; every existing scenario hash unchanged; κ = 0 is byte-identical to today. - One rng draw per step when σ > 0, none otherwise (determinism contract of 1.5). - κ from the fit rule only; standard error reported. - Python 3.12-compatible.

interfaces.interface: --csv (default the calm series), --interval 12, --dry-run; prints phi, se, kappa_step, half_life_h, stationary_sd_bps

tests.standards: pytest; κ = 0 byte-identity on soros-baseline; OU with κ = 1 pins price to base; synthetic AR(1) series recovers its φ within tolerance; validator test; hash test.
